match.instructions: state.query is a Google search query, usually Vietnamese and sometimes without diacritics. state.page is the page of state.site that Google showed for that query: url, title, h1, meta description and opening text. Decide whether this page is the right page on the site to satisfy what the searcher wants.

criteria.serves: The main topic of the page is the topic of the query, and the page type fits the need: a service or price page for a query about hiring or choosing a provider, an explanation or guide for a query about learning.
criteria.partial: The page covers the query topic only as a subtopic or one section, or covers the right topic with a page type that does not fit the need.
criteria.mismatch: The page is mainly about a different topic than the query.

intent.instructions: Classify what the person searching state.query most likely wants.

criteria.informational: Learn a concept, definition, method, tool usage or how-to.
criteria.commercial: Find, compare, price or hire a provider, service, agency, course or paid tool.
criteria.navigational: Reach a specific brand, website or person by name.
